references.title: Employment Act 1968 ss.38(4), (6) and Fourth Schedule — overtime at 1.5× the hourly basic rate (12 × monthly basic ÷ (52 × 44)); the rate for a non-workman is capped at the $2,600 salary level, $13.60 an hour (MOM, Changes to the Employment Act from 1 April 2019)

description: Normal working-day overtime hours, paid at the statutory multiplier.

references.title: Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations; MOM, Overtime for part-time employees — hours within a comparable full-timer’s normal hours are paid at the hourly basic rate

description: Extra hours worked by a part-time employee beyond the agreed hours.

references.title: Employment (Part-Time Employees) Regulations; MOM, Overtime for part-time employees — hours beyond a comparable full-timer’s normal hours are paid at 1.5× the hourly basic rate

description: Overtime hours worked by a part-time employee, paid at the part-time overtime multiplier.

references.title: Employment Act 1968 s.37(2)–(3) — rest-day work is half/one day’s basic pay at the employee’s request and one/two days’ at the employer’s request

description: Hours worked on a rest day, paid at the statutory rest-day multiplier.

references.title: MOM, Part-time employment: rest days — rest-day hours between the part-timer’s and full-time normal hours are paid at the hourly basic rate

description: Extra hours worked by a part-time employee on a rest day.

references.title: MOM, Part-time employment: rest days — rest-day hours beyond full-time normal hours are paid at 1.5× the hourly basic rate

description: Overtime worked by a part-time employee on a rest day, paid at the rest-day multiplier.

references.title: Employment Act 1968 s.88(4) — an employee required to work on a public holiday is paid an extra day's salary at the basic rate of pay (MOM, Public holidays: entitlement and pay)

description: Hours worked on a statutory holiday, paid at the statutory holiday multiplier.
